test_order_observability: test that polars query optimizer drops redundant SORT when group_by keys match sort keys
test_remove_double_sort: test that duplicate sorts on the same column are collapsed into a single SORT in the query plan
test_merge_sorted_to_union: test that merge_sorted followed by unique is optimized to UNION when order is not observed
test_order_sensitive_aggregations_parame: test which aggregations are order-sensitive such as first implode and arg_min
test_order_sensitive_paramateric: test order sensitivity of various expressions like sort gather explode and filter
test_with_columns_sensitivity: test how with_columns affects order observability based on column expressions used
test_reverse_non_order_observe: test that reverse followed by sum does not require order but reverse with last does
test_group_by_key_sensitivity: test which group_by key expressions preserve or break order observability
test_sort_key_sensitivity: test which sort key expressions trigger additional SORT BY in the query plan
test_filter_sensitivity: test which filter expressions require SORT in the query plan after filtering
test_partition_sink_sensitivity: test that partition sink respects order observability from cumulative expressions
test_order_sensitive_exprs_24335: test that order sensitive expressions like arange row_index and gather preserve ordering
test_sort_on_agg_maintain_order: test that sorting before group_by with agg preserves sorted column order
test_with_columns_implicit_columns: test that overwriting all columns in with_columns removes order requirement
